description: Sangam SDK conformance vectors (SGM-306 §2). Every SDK runs these in its own test suite; a change here is a change to every SDK.

permissions.description: One permission rule everywhere: granted at the organisation, or at an ancestor whose membership inherits (SangamMembership.Covers). Deny by default. Organisation paths end with '/'; comparison of paths is case-insensitive, of roles and permissions case-sensitive.

has_permission.why: granted at the parent without inheritance does not reach a ward
granted at the group with inheritance reaches a ward two levels down
an unrelated tree is not covered
a path without its trailing slash is a different organisation
a path that only starts with the same characters is not a child

cases.why: one factor does not meet two
a signature level is capped at five minutes even with no max_age
a longer max_age cannot lift the five-minute cap
two-factor within five minutes meets a signature
phishing-resistant within five minutes meets a signature
one factor never meets a signature

challenge.header: Bearer error="insufficient_user_authentication", error_description="A stronger or more recent authentication is required", acr_values="urn:sangam:acr:2"
Bearer error="insufficient_user_authentication", error_description="A stronger or more recent authentication is required", acr_values="urn:sangam:acr:sign", max_age=300

cases.why: the published Standard Webhooks test vector
more than five minutes in the future
after a rotation the header carries two signatures; the new secret matches the second
the old secret matches the first

validation.why: the example of SGM-208 §2.1
another major schema version
no event_id
event_id not a UUID
event_id a UUID but not version 7
occurred_at not RFC 3339
occurred_at with an offset is RFC 3339 and valid
no source.app_id
environment not one of the three
actor.type not one of the five
a user without actor.sub
actor.sub an e-mail address (people are identified by subject id only)
action not domain.object.verb
another valid action
category not one of the nine
outcome not success, failure or denied
no target.id
data_classification not one of the five
a person's event without client details
a system event needs no person or client
an api event names its client
an api event without actor.client_id
a sign event without its signature
changes as field, before, after
a change without its field
recorded_at is set by the service, never by the application
hash is set by the service, never by the application

builder.description: audit.record(...) fills source, tenant, actor and client from configuration, the signed-in user and the request; masks sensitive fields in changes; never sets recorded_at, prev_hash or hash.
